observations: A black ground holds two large face-like forms side by side: the left built around concentric orange-and-red rings with a single eye at center, the right showing an open-mouthed form with visible teeth at lower right.
Yellow zigzag borders run along the top and bottom edges; vertical blue bands frame the left and right sides, creating a flat rectangular border that contains the interior tangle.
Loose white line loops, brown scribble hatching, and pink and blue color blocks layer over and between the two face-like forms, with a column of small blue circles descending near the image center.
reading: Two face-like forms share a black field without merging—one eye sits inside a ring target on the left, the other form opens wide at lower right with visible teeth. A yellow zigzag border holds the composition in a tight frame while brown scribble lines and loose white loops fill the space between. The ringed eye reads as fixed and unblinking; the open mouth reads as a shout.
